evidence_quotes.section1_quid_pro_quo: Rep jumps directly into pricing explanation ('Let me explain how our pricing works then') with no time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote. No wait for customer agreement before starting.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Date range obtained ('between the 9th of October and the 14th of October') and target date confirmed (10th). No city-to-city route asked. No home size probed in discovery (size emerges later as '2000 square foot home' but rep states this, not customer). Name confirmed at top.
evidence_quotes.section2_their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves straight into pricing without exploring customer concerns beyond what was already in pre-call videos.
evidence_quotes.section3_logistics: Minimal probing. Rep references '2000 square foot home' and full packing/moving, but these appear to be rep assumptions or info from videos, not discovered on this call. No property type, floor/stories, room count, walking distance, additional rooms, special considerations, or additional stops asked.
evidence_quotes.section3_packing: Packing mentioned: 'in your case we're doing full packing and also moving' and later 'for packing you only needed to have partial. We can always do that' — offered as a service option.
evidence_quotes.section4_estimate_anchor: Gives typical range for 2000 sq ft ('normally takes four movers and two trucks... between six and a half to eight and a half hours') but personalizes only by stating 'in your case we're doing full packing and also moving. So we will schedule moving to two days' — addresses packing specifically but estimate ($8,117 over two days) does not tie explicitly to customer's stated concerns or prep level.
evidence_quotes.section4_pricing_framing: Full transparency on fees (no credit card fees, storage fees, disassemble/reassembly, etc.), 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments, and time starts when crew arrives on site all covered. 'Does not necessarily mean that you need to pay for seven hours even if they end up less than that.'
evidence_quotes.section4_feels_fair: Not asked. Rep moves directly from estimate to availability/booking without a pause or 'does that feel fair' check.
evidence_quotes.section5_on_time_guarantee: Fully delivered: 'we have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.section5_damage_coverage: Fully delivered: 'we have no worry damage coverage included on the early we that you're paying us. We will provide up to $2,000 per move that is to repair replace and reimburse for items.' Built into rate (included on the early rate), no deductible mentioned explicitly but no deductible framing not stated.
evidence_quotes.section5_closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not ask 'does that put those to rest?' or equivalent after delivering the two promises. Moves directly to booking availability.
evidence_quotes.section6_final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep does not circle back with 'what's still concerning you' or genuine concern check. Jumps to explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.section6_catch_all: Not asked. No 'anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.section7_explicit_ask: Full and clean: 'Either that side that you believe that we're the best mover in town. Do you want our help with your upcoming move?' [Note: transcription garbles 'Either that side' but intent is clear as a direct ask.] Asked plainly, no soft out provided.
evidence_quotes.section7_rate_lock: Mentioned: 'no deposit required no rest and securing your spot.'
evidence_quotes.section7_booking_confirmed: No confirmation attempted. Customer declines to commit pending comparison with competitor quote ($5,000). Rep does not circle back to secure any details — no date re-confirmed, no phone, no arrival window, no crew size, no addresses, no crew notes. Call ends without a booking.

top_strength: Rep delivered clear, complete pricing framing with full fee transparency and 2.5-hour minimum/15-minute increment commitment, and both Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) were stated fully and without hedging.
coaching_note: Stop at Section 1 and ask the customer's concerns ('Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?') before launching into pricing — you jumped straight to the estimate without understanding what matters to this customer, which left you unable to personalize the quote or address the competitor comparison objection when it came.
